name: infintyband
blurb: Infinite scrolling band of social icons with fade masks.
description: Horizontally scrolling band of social media icons/links that loops continuously using CSS keyframe animation. Includes fade gradient masks at edges.
use_when: Footer or sidebar sections showcasing social links, partners, or integrations.
avoid_when: When all content must be keyboard-navigable — looping animations make focused navigation harder.
a11y: Links are semantic HTML with proper hrefs; animation is visual effect on continuous scrolling.
